title: Recording: Love In Song by Wings | 1975
content:
Studio 3, Wally Heider Recording, Los Angeles
Producer: Paul McCartney
Engineer: Alan O’Duffy

Wings worked on the Venus And Mars song ‘Love In Song’ on 27 February 1975.

The backing track had been recorded at Abbey Road on 7 November 1974.

During this session, Paul McCartney recorded his lead vocals in two attempts. The final version was a composite of both.

It was followed by backing vocals, by Paul, Linda McCartney, and Denny Laine.
